hero_lede: Pick a group and subject, then open a path. Content comes from data files — not hard-coded UI.
empty_catalog: No paths in this catalog yet.
footer_catalog: Content-driven catalog · human publish for new paths · Grade-3 demos preloaded
login_lede: First name, last name, and a unique email. No passwords in this phase. The session cookie holds only an opaque user id — never the email as a secret.
path_map_lede: Each square is a topic — with learning steps inside. Pick a topic or start from the beginning.
record_hint: Optional recording — if the browser supports it.
stats_message: Great job — you finished the path!
stats_message_retry: Worth revisiting a few steps to strengthen.
gate_practice: Finish this step before moving on.
empty_tab: No paths in this tab yet.
home_tabs_lede: Tabs show paths you started, finished, or should revisit. The full catalog stays available.
login_email_note: Email uniquely identifies the user. No passwords in this phase.
err_name_required: First and last name are required.
err_email_taken: That email is already registered — try again or check the details.
add_path_gate_lede: To add a path you must connect an OpenAI-style agent API token (Authorization Bearer / API key) for a one-shot server-side check.
add_path_unlocked: First criterion met — you can continue the add-a-path flow.
add_path_next_steps: Full path creation comes next. Publishing remains human-only.
add_path_no_token_hint: Without a verified token this session, the old author POC is not opened.
security_note_body: Never paste tokens into pages that store them. This POC does not persist secrets — not in the database, cookies, localStorage, or logs. The token is accepted only for a single server-side check request and discarded immediately.
